axes.concept: Operational project register: names, owners, true save state and opening remain aligned in one working surface.
axes.layout: Pictures/Sempertex shell and horizontal route rule above one full-width ruled list; Taller preserves its toolbar, tool rail, canvas and inspector; import is an inline first-sign-in prompt above the list.
axes.navigation: Shared account disclosure and Proyectos/Taller routes; rows open directly without a detail rail; owner filter and name search share a bar; contextual name/load/leave dialogs.
axes.typography: Existing local Geist Sans: 24px page title, 20px section title, 17px project names, 14px actions and 12–13px supporting data; Geist Mono limited to existing metadata/count roles.
axes.density: One continuous 28px-inset paper, 24px ruled rows, 20px phone insets, 44px actions. Desktop groups owner/status/open on the name baseline; phone stacks identity above owner and status beside Open.
axes.components: Installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Skeleton, Animate UI Dialog and AlertDialog; native role/owner/language selectors and account details; no ornamental card grid.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures globals.css light/dark tokens, inherited SP-2/SP-14 role aliases and rounded shapes. Accent on primary action, semantic success/warning/error on actual status. Input and outline-control boundaries use texto-tenue.
axes.motion: Precise registration: 360ms cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1) paper 8px, row 10px with 28ms offsets, feedback -6px, status -5px; 150ms button lift/press/arrow/focus. Saving rotates and skeleton compresses; reduced/still settles instantly, hidden-tab animations pause.
